candidateTask: IPv4 TCP inbound connection_abuse at one host service

development.benignGroups: publisher BENIGN, 15-minute background blocks; not independent controlled tasks
development.finalProfileSupervision: matched publisher labels, known direction, whole parent and label inside partition, clean quality
development.prefixSupervision: diagnostic only until separate onset adjudication; structural candidate is insufficient
development.duplicatePolicy: same parent/activity stays in one partition; normalized final feature signature at 100ms age and 1ms IAT precision excludes all cross-partition near-duplicate parents
development.weightPolicy: each retained parent has total sample weight 1
development.wholeParentExclusion: any ambiguous, Attempted, unsupported-family or cross-boundary label segment excludes the entire parent

finalTest.requirement: new unexposed independent same-family positive activities plus corresponding difficult benign tasks; freeze hashes and access policy before P6

selectionBudget.calibration: separate validation activity groups required before P3 calibration; current one positive validation activity does not satisfy this gate

decisionEvaluation.blockPrecision: correct attack-target actions / all actions; undefined with zero actions
decisionEvaluation.blockRecall: timely covered supported attack episodes / all supported attack episodes
decisionEvaluation.falseBlockRate: blocked benign opportunities / all benign opportunities
decisionEvaluation.confidenceIntervals: bootstrap clustered by independent activity/capture; report unavailable with insufficient groups
decisionEvaluation.modelContribution: rules vs model vs model+policy at identical false-block budget; no payload onset rule is a model input

failurePolicy: retain failures; label/temporal defects return to P2, model benefit failure to P3, platform/recovery failure to P5; never tune using final_test
revisionReason: scope audit before model selection: other services cannot count as same-service benign evidence
